# Question 1: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r}
v1=c(1,0.846,0.805,0.859,0.473,0.398,0.301,0.382)
v2=c(0.846,1,0.881,0.826,0.376,0.326,0.277,0.415)
v3=c(0.805,0.881,1,0.816,0.380,0.319,0.237,0.345)
v4=c(0.859,0.826,0.801,1,0.380,0.319,0.237,0.345)
v5=c(0.473,0.376,0.380,0.436,1,0.329,0.327,0.365)
v6=c(0.398,0.326,0.319,0.329,0.762,1,0.730,0.629)
v7=c(0.301,0.277,0.237,0.327,0.730,0.583,1,0.577)
v8=c(0.382,0.415,0.345,0.365,0.629,0.577,0.539,1)
(Sigma=matrix(c(v1,
               v2,
               v3,
               v4,
               v5,
               v6,
               v7,v8),nrow=8,ncol=8,byrow=T))

colnames(Sigma)=paste("X_",1:8)

# Eigen Decomposition of Sigma

eigen_decomp=eigen(Sigma)
eigen_values=eigen(Sigma)$values
eigen_vector=eigen(Sigma)$vectors

total_variance=sum(eigen_values)
percent_variation=eigen_values/total_variance
cumulative_perc=cumsum(percent_variation)

(summary_frame=data.frame(Eigen_Values=eigen_values,Percent_Variation=percent_variation,Cumulative_Perc_Variation=cumulative_perc))


plot(1:8,(summary_frame$Cumulative_Perc_Variation),main='Scree Plot',xlab='eigen Values for Sigma Matrix',ylab='Cumulative Percent Variation Explained',col='blue',type='b')
```

# Question 2

```{r}
#| echo: false

(Sigma1=matrix(c(8,2,3,1,
                2,5,-1,3,
                3,-1,6,-2,
                1,3,-2,7),4,4))

S11=Sigma1[1:2,1:2]
S22=Sigma1[3:4,3:4]
S12=Sigma1[1:2,3:4]

library(expm)

A=solve(sqrtm(S22))%*%t(S12)%*%solve(sqrtm(S11))

AA_=A%*%t(A);A_A=t(A)%*%A

E1=eigen(AA_)$values
E2=eigen(A_A)$values

Eigen_vectors=eigen(AA_)$vectors

(U1=Eigen_vectors[,1]%*%solve(sqrtm(S11)))
(V1=Eigen_vectors[,1]%*%solve(sqrtm(S22)))
(U2=Eigen_vectors[,2]%*%solve(sqrtm(S11)))
(V2=Eigen_vectors[,2]%*%solve(sqrtm(S22)))
(dt=cbind(t(U1),t(V1),t(U2),t(V2)))

canonical_corr <- sqrt(E1)
canonical_corr
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

```{r Verification CCa}
(cancor(S11,S22))

```

```{r}
# fixed canonical correlation code
library(expm)   # for sqrtm

Sigma1 <- matrix(c(
  8,  2,  3,  1,
  2,  5, -1,  3,
  3, -1,  6, -2,
  1,  3, -2,  7), 4, 4, byrow = TRUE)

S11 <- Sigma1[1:2, 1:2]   # cov(X)
S22 <- Sigma1[3:4, 3:4]   # cov(Y)
S12 <- Sigma1[1:2, 3:4]   # cov(X,Y)
S21 <- t(S12)

# construct the whitened cross-covariance A = S22^{-1/2} S21 S11^{-1/2}
A <- solve(sqrtm(S22)) %*% S21 %*% solve(sqrtm(S11))

# SVD of A
sv <- svd(A)
P <- sv$u        # left singular vectors (for Y side, in whitened space)
D <- sv$d        # singular values = canonical correlations
Q <- sv$v        # right singular vectors (for X side, in whitened space)

# canonical correlation coefficients for original variables
# columns of 'a' are coefficient vectors for X; columns of 'b' for Y
a <- solve(sqrtm(S11)) %*% Q   # a: 2 x r  (X-side coefficients)
b <- solve(sqrtm(S22)) %*% P   # b: 2 x r  (Y-side coefficients)

# canonical correlations (should be the singular values)
canonical_correlations <- D

# check: covariance matrix between canonical variates = t(a) %*% S12 %*% b
corr_matrix_between_variates <- t(a) %*% S12 %*% b

# since a and b produce unit-variance canonical variates, diagonal of corr_matrix = D
diag_corrs <- diag(corr_matrix_between_variates)

# check variances of canonical variates (should be ~1)
var_U <- diag(t(a) %*% S11 %*% a)
var_V <- diag(t(b) %*% S22 %*% b)

# print results
cat("Canonical correlations (singular values):\n")
print(canonical_correlations)

cat("\nCovariance/correlation matrix between canonical variates (t(a) %*% S12 %*% b):\n")
print(round(corr_matrix_between_variates, 8))

cat("\nDiagonal (should equal canonical correlations):\n")
print(round(diag_corrs, 8))

cat("\nVariances of canonical variates (should be 1):\n")
print(round(var_U, 8))
print(round(var_V, 8))

```
